Microeconomics

Students will learn how to apply economics to make informed business decisions through the study of key microeconomic principles.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of key microeconomic concepts and principles.

+  Understand and apply basic statistics and understand how these can be important for microeconomic analysis.

+  Apply basic economic theory and principles to different current microeconomic issues and/or societal situations

+  Evaluate and analyse arguments and scenarios and apply the economics principles to solve microeconomic and managerial problems.
